dog.description_text:
Hi, I'm Nubbin, a 6-month-old tan-and-white bicolor mixed breed pup ready to steal your heart! 🐶 At 17.1 lbs, I'm a medium-sized guy, already neutered, with a medium energy level. I'm affectionate, cuddly, and friendly, with a loyal and playful streak I'd love to share with my new family. 💛 I'm adventurous at heart, so I'm excited to explore the world with you. Come meet me today and see if we're a perfect match! 🐾
This animal is located at our Westhampton Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. We are open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age appropriate shots. Apply for Adoption Today!
